items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: You said, “Oh I’m just here practicing with my Jamey Aebserold.”

ctx.x: on. The following day I got up and did a shoot just like this for my niece who was putting together this footage. And I got on the bus that evening and in about three or four days I covered all forms of media.
Wow. You know you said something that just struck me so much when I called you last week I guess. You said, “Oh I’m just here practicing with my Jamey Aebserold.”
